notes: two «ح»-branches: the first ends at «عبد الله بن نمير», the second runs through «ابن نمير» and «أبي» (the father, a bare relation)
«حدثنا أبي، حدثنا عبيد الله» : the shared tail begins at «عبيد الله», the first name both routes share; «أبي» is the second branch's own
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«عبد الله بن نمير» and «ابن نمير» are written differently: not merged (rule 9)
